On fresh seeds the boundary shares match the seat's, and the label reading still does not push still pieces apart (gains of 0.01 or less, 0.05 needed). The kill is right. Fixes are small: label one explanation as a proposal, score one registered side test (pieces by lineage exist only with the reading on over supplied regions), and tidy a few counts and line numbers.
